documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported a 58.60% year-on-year growth in total consolidated income for Q2 FY27 and 47% growth in H1 FY27 income from operations to INR 194.9 crores. Management projects revenue growth of more than 30% for FY27 and FY28, driven by domestic demand, US export growth, and expanding opportunities in Europe. To enhance productivity and counter rising raw material costs, the company plans to invest around INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and INR 4.5 crores in Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months. CapEx continues to be funded via internal accruals without taking term loans. Menon Bearings Limited presented its Q2 & H1FY27 financial and operational performance, reporting consolidated revenue from operations of ₹100.88 crore for Q2 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line growth of more than 30% for FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: The company expects additional business of around INR 30 crores on a consolidated basis for FY27.
guidance.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: Estimated additional business for FY28 is expected to be INR 131 crores.
guidance.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%, with '28-'29, the growth driver, we are having the list of all customers also from whom we are estimated to get the business, RFQs are there, and discussions are going on, commercials have been finalized.

guidance.claim: The company targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for the next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: Management expects potential additional business of INR 65 crores to INR 75 crores across the current and next financial year.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: The company considers INR 360 crores in revenue to be a conservative figure for the financial year.
guidance.quote: So, INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

guidance.claim: Management is targeting Alkop revenue of INR 100 crores for this year and around INR 125 crores next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: The company has set a conservative target of 20% plus year-on-year growth.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports to reach 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach INR 500 crores in revenue in the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: We were supposed to reach INR500 crore in 2030, but we are trying to do it as soon as possible.

demand_outlook.claim: A recent tour to Europe has yielded potential business of more than INR 35 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM business grew by almost 50% and export business grew by more than 75% compared to the same quarter last year.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a growth in OEM's business by almost 50%, and similarly there is a growth in export more than 75%.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sectors remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Merchant export orders were delayed for three months due to war and backlog at the Strait of Hormuz.
demand_outlook.quote: So actually, our results could have been even better. But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue potential from Africa is estimated at around INR 9 crores for bearings, bushes, and washers, and INR 6 to 7 crores for brake linings.
demand_outlook.quote: You see the possible revenue from Africa so far as bearing, bushes and washers are concerned is around INR9 crores. And at the same time, we are working on supplies to Africa so far as brake linings are concerned, and that is expected to be around INR6 crores to INR7 crores for the year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest around INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and INR 4.5 crores in Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months.
capex_expansion.quote: And I will not say only for automation and R&D how much we are investing, but next two years in Menon Bearings and Alkop, 12 months, around INR5 crores in Menon Alkop and around INR4.5 crores in Menon Bearings.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects the return on investment (ROI) for these CapEx projects to be around 2.5 to 3 years.
capex_expansion.quote: So this is the investment we are getting, and roughly ROI will be in the next 2.5, 3 years, should be the return on investment on this investment what we are doing.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional capex of ₹2.50 crore is planned for the Brakes division over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: Five robotic automation initiatives are scheduled to roll out between November 2026 and April 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Five initiatives rolling out Nov 2026 – Apr 2027 to lift productivity, quality and machine utilization

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores in the current financial year to increase capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: If you go through the presentation, Rucheeta, you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned CapEx of around INR 4 crores for the year in the Alkop division alone.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The company constructed a new 65,000 square feet building for the machine shop in the aluminium division with 50% capacity available.
capex_expansion.quote: And in aluminium division also, we have done 65,000 square feet new building, a machine shop, which is 50% land, like what do you say?

capex_expansion.claim: Future CapEx is expected to yield an asset turn of around 2.5.
capex_expansion.quote: See, whatever future CapEx that we are going to do, the additional CapEx will have asset turn of around 2.5.

margins_costs.claim: Tin prices rose by 72%, copper by 50%, and steel by 12%.
margins_costs.quote: Just to put in numbers, tin has increased by 72%, copper by 50%, steel by 12%.

margins_costs.claim: A decline in aluminium raw material prices will benefit the Alkop segment.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, obviously, the rates of aluminium, basically that is the raw material and various aluminium alloys we are applying as a raw material, the prices are down to some extent, and the benefit of which will accrue to the Alkop.

margins_costs.claim: Margins stand at 30% to 35% in Brakes, 18% to 19% in Alkop, and 23% in Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: Okay, so far as Brakes is concerned, the margins are 30% to 35%. It depends upon the mix of the product, but it is between 30% to 35%, okay, that is one thing. In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: The company expects to sustain consolidated margins of around 20% to 21% over time.
margins_costs.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin in the brakes division reached 25% during the quarter due to product mix.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of consumable items such as carbide tools have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA grew by approximately 60% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.
Consolidated EBITDA increased by 57% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: And EBITDA on a consolidated basis is up by 57%.

orders_capacity.claim: For Menon Alkop, 54 new parts were developed in the last two years and start of business has begun.
orders_capacity.quote: For Menon Alkop, we have developed around 54 parts in the last two years, and they all SOB has begun.

orders_capacity.claim: Productivity has increased by 25% over the previous period.
orders_capacity.quote: Apart from that, you can see there is a volume growth and productivity has substantially increased, that is by 25% over last period.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in the bi-metal bearing segment is currently around 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: Roughly, I will tell you bearing around 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: Peak revenue from existing bi-metal bearing capacity can exceed INR 400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Menon Brakes expects railway business of INR 5 crores to INR 6 crores in the first year, rising to INR 25 crores to INR 30 crores within two years.
orders_capacity.quote: with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

capital_allocation.claim: The company holds cash and bank balances including mutual funds of INR 25.69 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: PAT by 117%, and similarly EPS also has -- there is a growth of 117% over last year with cash and bank balance including mutual funds is INR 25.69 crores- plus.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx is being funded out of internal accruals, with no term loans taken for over six months.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, basically what we have done in the past for more than six months, we have not availed any term loan. Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Planned CapEx for the bi-metal and Alkop divisions will be funded entirely through internal accruals without taking fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: US market demand faces volatility due to political commentary, tariffs, and exit policies.
risks_headwinds.quote: US has been a little bit volatile because of Mr. Trump's comments and what he's saying, tariffs, exit policies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were disrupted over the last three months due to war and shipping backlog at the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: So actually, our results could have been even better. But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Drought-like conditions in certain parts may impact tractor segment demand to some extent.
risks_headwinds.quote: You see, considering the monsoon position that may -- in tractor segment affect today to some extent, not larger, because in some parts there is a drought-like situation, but it is expected to improve within this month or next month.

risks_headwinds.claim: Basic ship cargo transportation costs have increased significantly.
risks_headwinds.quote: Basic ship cargo transportation has increased significantly. Indian transport has increased.
